description:
Hi! I'm Rohith Raj, a student interested in technology, coding, innovation, and fire safety. I've worked on projects like a harmful gas detector and a fire engine robot.

Our team, Agni Rakshakar 🔥, aims to develop innovative solutions for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. I'm looking for teammates skilled in Python, AI/ML, web development, data analysis, design, and research. Enthusiasm, creativity, and teamwork are always welcome.

Let's learn, innovate, and build something amazing together
